{{Quote|As is evident by its designation, the AT-PT is operated by a single trooper. It turns a soldier into an armored, elevated weapons platform, and adds extra firepower to a standard infantry formation.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB" />}}
The '''All Terrain Personal Transport (AT-PT)''' was a light anti-infantry [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and, later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. Made to take a single trooper into an intense combat situation on his own, it was the basis for the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Sure, they don't look like much. But when you're trapped on Eos, where the electromagnetic fields keep 'advanced' airspeeders grounded, you'll wish you had a whole fleet of AT-PTs.|[[Imperial commander]] [[Brenn Tantor]]|<ref name="EGVV" />}}
[[File:AT-PT_schem.jpg|thumb|left|200px|AT-PT [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]
AT-PTs were made to take single troopers into intense combat situations on their own, with the firepower of a squad. They stood only three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and were driven by [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-PT pilots]].

The [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] were capable of reaching speeds up to 60 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] and could climb a 45-degree angle, with hydraulic adjusters keeping the unit balanced. The vehicles carried a long-range comm antenna for patrols. The main drive unit provided power and hydraulic pressure for the two legs, and featured cooling vents. The [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] entry hatch was on the side,<ref name="RS I guide" /> while the emergency flare launcher was just above the [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]].<ref name="RS II guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>

The AT-PT was &mdash; compared to its intended threat, enemy soldiers &mdash; heavily armored, enough so that small-arms fire could not penetrate the craft's armor. The walker was armed with twin [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and one [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] launcher, which were only effective against infantry. The walker's superior agility made up for its light armor (in comparison to most other cavalry units).

[[File:Light_All_Terrain_Personal_Transport.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Light All Terrain Personal Transports.]]
The units often traveled in packs for increased firepower.<ref name="RS II guide" />

AT-PTs were upgraded versions of [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|Light All Terrain Personal Transports]], which had a more fragile chassis as well as a bubble canopy that offered greater visibility than the Standard AT-PT's vision slit. Both were constructed at Imperial [[Factory/Legends|mech factories]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|I don't understand why they keep making these walkers.|Rachi Sitra|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
[[File:Targeted_Strike_DC_Mariusz_Gandzel.png|thumb|left|220px|An AT-PT disabled by a missile shot to the leg joint]]
The AT-PT was designed for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but during the war, the Republic found a need for a small, anti-personnel walker, and the AT-PT became more relevant. It was one of the earliest [[AT-series/Legends|AT series]] transports.

The AT-PT was a limited production model, the majority of which were stationed aboard the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class cruisers]] of the legendary [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]], and many were lost when the fleet itself vanished.

Many of the concepts pioneered in the AT-PT were used in the [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] utilized a number of the walkers. They were often used as sentries and patrol vehicles near Imperial installations.

Imperial commander [[Brenn Tantor]] ordered the use of AT-PTs in several battlefronts prior to his defection.<ref name="SW:FC">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref> Tantor also used them during the [[Battle of Eos]].<ref name="EGVV" />

[[File:Trandoshans_At-PT_EotE_by_Christopher_Burdett.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Two [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] escorting an AT-PT.]]
Large numbers of AT-PTs were used in the [[Defense of Ralltiir|Battle of Ralltiir]] soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], where most of them were destroyed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> Three AT-PTs were carried aboard a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] during the [[Search for the Nonnah|search]] for the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Nonnah]]''. They also guarded a [[Jade Moon supply base|supply base]] on the [[Jade Moon]]. Several were also on [[Gerrard V]] during the planet's [[Liberation of Gerrard V|liberation]]. Soon after, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] [[Escape from Fest|stole]] three AT-PTs from the [[Weapons Research Facility]] on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]; they were protected during their escape by the Rebel flight group [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="RS I" /> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] used AT-PTs during the [[Reytha campaign]] and the [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|Battle of Zaloriis]]. A number of AT-PTs also served as part of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] under Vader's command during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="SW:GB" /> AT-PTs also [[Battle near the Maw|patrolled]] an [[Maw Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. The [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']] carried a group of AT-PTs, which escaped from the ship's wreckage during the [[Battle of Kothlis]].<ref name="RS II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

The [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]] in [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]] used some three dozen AT-PTs during the [[Rebellion era]]. Due to the AT-PT being designed for [[Human/Legends|Human]] users, and to the Order being composed almost exclusively by [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] (who were larger than Humans), the Order's AT-PTs were commonly piloted by short Bitthævrians. It was believed that the Order took control of those AT-PTs by boarding a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship in one of the rare situations where Bitthævrians left Guiteica.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

The walkers of the Katana fleet, along with the fleet itself, were rediscovered by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and were used in the Republic's war against [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="EGVV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AT-PT.jpg|thumb|left|160px|An AT-PT.]]
In ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', the cost of an AT-PT was specified as 15,000 credits and its capacity as 25 kilograms; those stats were superseded by later publications.

The walkers first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]''. In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', the AT-PTs serve as the Empire's Heavy Strike Mech unit.

Originally, the AT-PT's forward viewport was restricted to a small window near the roof, with a large anti-glare panel below it. Sometime after its first appearance in the West End Games' ''Dark Force Rising Sourcebook'', the anti-glare panel was mistaken for the lower half of the viewport and almost every image of the walker since then has carried over this mistake.

A walker with the designation of AT-PT was developed by Pandemic Studios for the original ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', but was cut from the game. Unlike the Imperial version, this walker featured a sleek pod with an open design.

The AT-PT was created by Ralph McQuarrie as the original concept that would later be modified to become the AT-ST.
